title: Bayesian segmentation of brainstem structures in MRI

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Bayesian segmentation of brainstem structures in MRI》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】In this paper we present a method to segment four brainstem structures (midbrain, pons, medulla oblongata and superior cerebellar peduncle) from 3D brain MRI scans.

evidence.text: In this paper we present a method to segment four brainstem structures (midbrain, pons, medulla oblongata and superior cerebellar peduncle) from 3D brain MRI scans.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Bayesian segmentation of brainstem structures in MRI》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Using cross validation, we show that the algorithm can segment the structures in previously unseen T1 and FLAIR scans with great accuracy (mean error under 1mm) and robustness (no failures in 383 scans including 168 AD cases).

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】We also indirectly evaluate the algorithm with a experiment in which we study the atrophy of the brainstem in aging.

evidence.text: Using cross validation, we show that the algorithm can segment the structures in previously unseen T1 and FLAIR scans with great accuracy (mean error under 1mm) and robustness (no failures in 383 scans including 168 AD cases).
We also indirectly evaluate the algorithm with a experiment in which we study the atrophy of the brainstem in aging.
